notes.title: Full Release Patch #4: Minor Update
notes.notes:
Full Release version 2022-08-06 changelog:
- Bugfix: Rare crash during the Hall Guardian and the Snow Bear Fighters battles.
- Bugfix: Not drawing weapons anymore during cutscenes if no weapons are equipped.
- Bugfix: Aura quick flash on known battlezones.
- Skill and Fury levels are now displayed on the field menu.

notes.title: Full Release Patch #3: Minor Update
notes.notes:
Full Release version 2022-07-13 changelog:
- Using the same summon more than once on the same level caused a black screen - fixed.
- Basic mouse support as requested: Validate with left click, Cancel with right click, A.R Goggles with Middle Click.
- Added a (very) short Anime cutscene just before the first new partner joins the party.
And a few more minor improvements and fixes.

notes.title: Full Release Patch #2: Steam Deck support and more!
notes.notes:
Full Release version 2022-05-24 changelog:

- Bigger font for more readability on small screens such as the Steam Deck.
- Aura effect on the top of the screen when walking in a known battlezone, fading from green to red indicating the next encounter.
- You can now disable weapon elemental damage by pressing L1-R1 / ARROWS (left-right hand) when on the weapon's command.
- The various leaderboards are now visible on the title screen > extras menu.
- New option: Dark Theme.
- New option for choosing between Xbox and PlayStation gamepad glyphs.
- New option: Pixel transition, that looks great when using the CRT filter.
- New graphics option: Target framerate, from 30 to 120 FPS.
- Added a new movies quality: Very High.
- Added MacOSX M1 (Arm) native binaries.
- More UI performance optimizations on low-end devices.
- Preparations for smaller size updates from now on.

And many more improvements and fixes!

notes.title: Full Release Patch #1: A few improvements and fixes!
notes.notes:
Full Release version 2021-11-07 changelog
- Kid's steal skill now better indicate if it failed and why.
- Added a few missing events to the completion lists.
- Better performance in the Snow Forest. If you still have a low framerate, please set the Level of Details graphics option to low.
- The savepoints sound is now off by default - set it as you like it in the options.

notes.title: Early Access Patch #6: Release candidate!
notes.notes:
Early Access version 2021-08-19 changelog

- Implemented the in-game tips system featuring the cat girl Miyu ːlyingcatː

And a few more minor improvements and fixes.

I've finally implemented all the missing features, so this build is a release candidate for the full release!

If you still have any feedback left on this episode please let me know!

Again, thanks you so much for your continuous support and patience. We're getting there!

notes.title: Early Access Patch #5: The Mysterious Girl's Story!
notes.notes:
Early Access version 2021-08-07 changelog

- A new (very) short story featuring the mysterious girl as the playable character, which gives a bit more context on the ending in Haru's story.
- A new event about Daichi [spoiler]after reaching the Snow Forest and then returning to the Maze[/spoiler].

And a few more improvements and fixes!

notes.title: Early Access Patch #4: Better balancing for Ayaka!
notes.notes:
Early Access version 2021-07-11 changelog

- Ayaka's healing skills (Pray / Flowerbed) are now 20% less effective - they were too powerful and felt a bit like cheating as they don't consume MP. Thanks @thatdiesel!
- Fixed a possible crash on the Executioner battle. Thanks @Dalia!
- Added 2 pages to the instruction manual (title menu > Extras) listing all of the gamepad and keyboard controls.
- Improved stereoscopic 3D mode: Activate it in the options on the title menu, then go in-game and press F6-F7 to change the convergence and F8-F9 for the separation.

And a few more improvements and fixes!

notes.title: Early Access Patch #3: A few improvements
notes.notes:
Early Access version 2021-06-17 changelog

- Fast Forward can now be toggled by pressing once R3 / T. You can also still activate it as before by keep pressing L3 / F.
- The "Steal" skill now better indicate if it succeeded or failed.
- Fixed the pause menu window getting stuck on the screen - as reported on the discussions.
- And a few more fixes / improvements.

notes.title: Early Access Patch #2: Hard Mode
notes.notes:
Early Access version 2021-06-06 changelog

- New option: Hard Mode - that you can toggle anytime on the title menu - featuring a challenging battle difficulty similar to the initial release.
- Fixed the shops UI getting stuck when exiting - as reported in the discussions.
- A few more bugs fixed.

notes.title: Early Access Patch #1: Battle Balancing
notes.notes:
Early Access version 2021-06-01 changelog:

- Most enemies now have less HP, and do less damage.
- Kid is slightly stronger (STR) - can do more weapon damage now.
- Corrections on the French script thanks to @chtichoko.
- Each playable character have his own weapons and armors - now better indicated in shops.
- New option on the Title Screen > Options: Savepoints Sound. When unchecked the ringing sound of close-by savepoints will be disabled, as requested in the discussions.
- Removed the "Shorter Battle Animations" option. This only affected summons.
The new behavior is full summons animation the first time, and then the short version after that.
- And a few more minor improvements / fixes.

Please give it a try and leave your thoughts. Thanks!

Hi everyone!

Mark the date: Episode 2 of my Japanese-style RPG series Light Fairytale will release via Early Access on this Monday 24 May at 9:00 am PDT ːshokkuː

Wishlist it now to be notified on the release:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1199760

notes.title: Update on Light Fairytale Episode 2 (September 2020)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022398/540fbb12c1d76a8b3f7628cc3932493208896138.jpg

Hey guys! Here's a quick update about the current status and plans for episode 2 of my JRPG series Light Fairytale.

I've been focusing on the development of episode 2 since December 2019 and I'm happy to announce that it is now playable from start to finish in term of exploration and events! Including 3 towns and 3 dungeons.

I will now work on the battle part. I've done preliminary work on the 5 boss battles but still need to implement their unique skills. I've also implemented many normal battles but still lacking quite a few.

After that, I'll work on implementing a few new features, then start the finalization / polishing / testing process. That's around the time when I'll launch the Early Access on Steam as I will need testers.

The Early Access should still happen this year. Please wishlist episode 2 to be notified on the release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1199760

Here's a few work-in-progress screenshots. Again, thanks for your support and patience! This is a very ambitious project for a mostly solo effort, I'll hope you'll understand.

notes.title: Update on Light Fairytale Episode 2
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022398/e5bf2d59c06ec5fd9b8ad2cd40cd5e41867100f4.png

Hi everyone, quick update about Episode 2 of my turn-based Japanese-style RPG series Light Fairytale.

After the full release of Episode 1 on Steam in May 2019, I've been working on the consoles ports - PlayStation 4 and Xbox One - until the last release in the end of November 2019.

I was only able to focus on Episode 2 since December 2019, though the development is progressing smoothly. I've implemented 2 towns and 1 dungeon, I'm currently working on the 2nd dungeon. I'm planning 3 towns and 3 dungeons overall for this episode which should release on Steam around July 2020.

If you haven't already, please add it to your wishlist to be notified on the release!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/1199760

You can stay updated about my projects by following me on Twitter: twitter.com/bakanekofr

Here's a few work-in-progress shots bellow. Thanks for your support and patience!
